CENT's +16.8% spike signals retail momentum—ride it but set tight stops. Rotate into TOSK for e-commerce logistics leverage ahead of festive season.

Position for Q3 loan-growth acceleration and fee-income recovery, favoring niche lenders over big banks.

E-commerce and quick-commerce penetration in tier-2/3 cities is reshaping FMCG go-to-market, giving agile local players a structural cost and speed advantage over legacy incumbents.
sectors.ai: Buy dips in FMCG small/mid caps with confirmed volume breakouts (MSJA, FOLK, KING) as domestic demand holds firm despite US softness; rotate out of laggards lacking earnings catalysts. Target names with strong rural distribution and digital channel growth, as sector consolidation and premiumization sustain momentum through 2H25.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's Bappebti licensing regime is funneling retail crypto flows into compliant local exchanges, structurally favoring tokens with deep IDR liquidity pairs and regulatory clearance.
Global rate-cut expectations are compressing carry trade appeal, pushing capital into high-beta digital assets like AERO and INJ that offer leveraged upside to AI and DeFi narratives.
Token unlock schedules and vesting cliffs remain the dominant idiosyncratic risk, with VVV and WBT's recent surges likely front-running supply events that could cap sustained gains.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum into AERO, VVV, and INJ as liquidity rotates to high-beta infrastructure and AI-tied tokens; ignore DOT/VET laggards. Indonesia's crypto tax clarity and Bappebti licensing funnel retail volume to compliant exchanges, so overweight tokens with local listing depth. Trim WLD on valuation risk, keep stops tight given NORMAL signal and no ID-US split visibility.
